data.description: Create a durable testing handbook that labels every test suite/file by category, runner, environment, purpose, command, and evidence output; explain the accuracy hierarchy and known gaps; add guidance for where new tests belong; link the guide from README without moving existing test files.
data.title: Document and organize the testing system

data.body: Branch is intentionally stacked on frac-24-mobile-hero-polish because TESTING.md documents responsive/native infrastructure introduced across the current mobile-testing stack and not yet present on master.

Implementation complete: added TESTING.md with layer/command/evidence guidance and file-by-file catalogs for all 13 Vitest suites, all Playwright suites/support files/snapshots, all 11 native harness modules, and CI/conformance gates; linked and oriented README. Verification passed: catalog completeness, 52 relative Markdown links, 14 documented test/gate scripts, git diff --check, simulator self-test (host access required for embedded Chromium), pnpm typecheck, pnpm test (13 files/160 tests), pnpm build, and pnpm conformance.

PASS. Independently compared TESTING.md and README against the FRAC-25 plan and checked-in Vitest, Playwright, simulator, conformance, and CI sources. All 13 Vitest suites, 3 Playwright specs, 4 Playwright support modules, 11 native harness modules, 2 CI workflows, both test configs/setup, snapshot references, commands, 22/8 browser profiles, routes/redirects, 5 native profiles, and evidence paths are cataloged. Mechanical checks found 47 unique relative links with 0 missing, 31 catalog candidates with 0 missing, and all 14 documented package scripts present. Existing tests/config/source were not moved or changed. Fidelity distinctions and current gaps are honest, including no native-iOS success claim. Minor review fix e526ba5 clarifies that the fast lane and simulator self-test require a Chromium browser binary. Verification passed: pnpm typecheck; pnpm test (13 files, 160 tests); pnpm build; pnpm conformance; pnpm simulators:self-test (required unsandboxed local Chromium launch); git diff --check. Build retains the existing large-chunk warning only. Meets all acceptance criteria.

Independent review passed after a minor documentation-only prerequisite clarification. TESTING.md provides a complete, accurate labeled catalog and fidelity/evidence guide; README links and commands are correct. Verified all relative links, catalog coverage, documented scripts, unchanged test/config paths, typecheck, 160 unit tests, production build, design conformance, simulator harness self-test, and diff cleanliness. No implementation- or plan-level rework remains.
